# Zenoa (Inolas Nexus) - Full System Specification & Documentation

> **Zenoa** (https://zenoa.in) is the sovereign private communication ecosystem, business AI copilot platform, and developer gateway founded and architected by **Inolas Nexus**.

---

## 1. Core Architecture & Privacy Principles
- **Carrier-Grade Ephemeral Relay**: Zero cloud-side message retention, hardware-grade WebCrypto cryptography.
- **Unified Developer Authentication**: Standard single API Key (`ZENOA_API_KEY`) passed via HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <ZENOA_API_KEY>` or `X-Zenoa-Api-Key: <ZENOA_API_KEY>`.
- **Autonomous AI Copilot Engine**: Real-time customer cart, order status, and catalog reasoning with sub-500ms conversational inference.
- **Storefront Live Chat Integration**: 1-line script embed supporting both Floating Bubble and Embedded Inline Tab modes.

---

## 2. Developer Category Tiers
1. **Messenger Plan (`messenger`)**: Sub-second Carrier OTPs (`/api/v1/otp/send`, `/api/v1/otp/verify`) & Direct Bot DMs (`/api/v1/bot/send`).
2. **Business Suite (`business`)**: Autonomous AI Concierge (`/api/business/chat`), Conversations (`/api/business/conversations/:id`), and Live Storefront Chat Widget (`/widget/live-chat.js`).
3. **Hybrid Enterprise (`hybrid`)**: Unified Omnichannel Gateway supporting both Carrier OTP/Bot DMs, Autonomous Business AI Copilot, and Realtime Telemetry Analytics.

---

## 3. Complete Route & API Directory

### Public & Developer Portals
- **Homepage / Messenger**: [https://zenoa.in/](https://zenoa.in/)
- **Developer Console**: [https://zenoa.in/developer](https://zenoa.in/developer)
- **Interactive Documentation**: [https://zenoa.in/docs](https://zenoa.in/docs)
- **OpenAPI 3.1.0 Spec**: [https://zenoa.in/openapi.json](https://zenoa.in/openapi.json)
- **Agent Specification**: [https://zenoa.in/auth.md](https://zenoa.in/auth.md)

### Verified REST Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` — Returns system uptime, version, and latency SLA.
- `POST /api/v1/otp/send` — Dispatches carrier OTP passcode to phone or handle.
- `POST /api/v1/otp/verify` — Validates recipient OTP passcode.
- `POST /api/v1/bot/send` — Dispatches rich bot notifications & cards.
- `POST /api/business/chat` — Autonomous business AI customer copilot inference.
- `GET /api/business/conversations/:id` — Retrieves customer conversation history.
- `POST /api/business/conversations/:id/canned` — Dispatches pre-approved canned reply.
- `GET /openapi.json` — Complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema.

---

## 4. Multi-Language SDK Snippets

### TypeScript (Universal)
```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

export class ZenoaClient {
  private apiKey: string;
  private baseUrl: string;

  constructor(apiKey = process.env.ZENOA_API_KEY || "YOUR_ZENOA_API_KEY", baseUrl = "https://zenoa.in") {
    this.apiKey = apiKey;
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
  }

  private headers() {
    return {
      "Authorization": `Bearer ${this.apiKey}`,
      "X-Zenoa-Api-Key": this.apiKey,
      "Content-Type": "application/json"
    };
  }

  async sendOtp(recipient: string, templateType = "standard_otp") {
    const res = await axios.post(`${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/otp/send`, { recipient, template_type: templateType }, { headers: this.headers() });
    return res.data;
  }

  async verifyOtp(recipient: string, code: string) {
    const res = await axios.post(`${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/otp/verify`, { recipient, code }, { headers: this.headers() });
    return res.data;
  }

  async chat(sessionId: string, message: string, context: Record<string, any> = {}) {
    const res = await axios.post(`${this.baseUrl}/api/business/chat`, { session_id: sessionId, message, customer_context: context }, { headers: this.headers() });
    return res.data;
  }
}
```

### Python 3 SDK
```python
import os
import requests

class ZenoaClient:
    def __init__(self, api_key: str = None):
        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("ZENOA_API_KEY", "YOUR_ZENOA_API_KEY")
        self.base_url = "https://zenoa.in"

    def _headers(self):
        return {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "X-Zenoa-Api-Key": self.api_key,
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }

    def send_otp(self, recipient: str, template_type: str = "standard_otp"):
        return requests.post(f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/otp/send", json={"recipient": recipient, "template_type": template_type}, headers=self._headers()).json()

    def chat(self, session_id: str, message: str, context: dict = None):
        return requests.post(f"{self.base_url}/api/business/chat", json={"session_id": session_id, "message": message, "customer_context": context or {}}, headers=self._headers()).json()
```

### Web Storefront Live Chat Embed
```html
<!-- Floating Bubble Mode -->
<script 
  src="https://zenoa.in/widget/live-chat.js" 
  data-api-key="YOUR_ZENOA_API_KEY" 
  data-category="business"
  data-mode="bubble"
  data-position="bottom-right"
  async>
</script>
```
